name: Githzerai Zerth
tactics: A githzerai zerth spends its action point to use trace chance, then attacks the same foe with inner fire, teleporting it to a space where it can be isolated and attacked. The zerth then closes in on its enemies, pounding them with psychic fists and using avenging wind to deflect a ranged attack and teleport next to its attacker. Between unarmed strikes and inner fire attacks, the zerth uses reorder chaos to alter the complexion of the battlefield, swapping allies and enemies to its advantage.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: Lightning damage, and the target teleports 5 squares, to an unoccupied space of the zerth’s choosing

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: up to 4 Medium or smaller targets

hit.description: the targets teleport to swap spaces as the zerth chooses

powers.name: Avenging Wind
powers.trigger: when targeted by a ranged attack

effect.description: The attack targets another creature within 5 squares of the zerth, and the zerth teleports 10 squares into a square adjacent to the attacker.
The githzerai zerth gains a +2 bonus to all defenses until the end of its next turn.
no attack roll required; Ranged 5; the next melee attack made against the target gains a +5 power bonus to the attack roll and, if it hits, it is automatically a critical hit.
